name: Shatter
description:
Uncheck a Condition. Choose a point within medium range. You create an explosive concussion of force centered on that point. Roll Spirit vs Fortitude against each creature within short range of the point you chose. On each win, the creature takes 3d8 damage. On each loss, half damage. Either way, if the creature is made inorganic material such as stone, crystal, or metal, double the damage. Mundane objects within the area automatically take the damage.

If the Condition you unchecked was Angry, +1d damage.

Describe the sound.
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

🌞: On each win, the creature is knocked prone and deafened for 1 minute.
